errors.source_span: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

errors.source_span: as he said through his holy prophets of long ago

errors.explanation: Acceptable translation; no penalty.

errors.source_span: the oath he swore to our father Abraham

errors.explanation: Acceptable translation.

errors.source_span: to rescue us from the hand of our enemies, and to enable us to serve him without fear in holiness and righteousness before him all our days.

利8:
在圣洁和义面前,我们的日子都是如此的。

errors.source_span: And you, my child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for him,
errors.translation_span: 我的子阿、你必被称作至高的先知。 因为你必往耶和华面前行,为他作准备。
errors.explanation: Acceptable translation.

errors.source_span: to give his people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,

errors.source_span: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the rising sun will come to us from heaven
errors.translation_span: 因为我们的神的慈悲,使日从天上临到我们。

errors.source_span: to shine on those living in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace.

errors.source_span: And the child grew and became strong in spirit; and he lived in the wilderness until he appeared publicly to Israel.

errors.source_span: your prayer has been heard

errors.source_span: Elizabeth was not able to conceive
errors.translation_span: 因为伊利莎白是不孕的

errors.source_span: He is never to take wine or other fermented drink

errors.source_span: wondering why he stayed so long in the temple

errors.source_span: They realized he had seen a vision in the temple, for he kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak

errors.source_span: The Lord has done this for me,” she said. “In these days he has shown his favor and taken away my disgrace among the people

The phrase '取消了' (cancelled) is not the best choice here; '除去了' or '消除了' (removed) would be more accurate and natural in this context.

errors.source_span: the angel Gabriel

errors.source_span: "Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you."

errors.source_span: since I am a virgin?

errors.source_span: Then the angel left her.
errors.translation_span: 然后,天使离开她,去见伊丽莎白.
errors.explanation: The source only says 'Then the angel left her,' but the translation adds '去见伊丽莎白' ('went to see Elizabeth'), which is an addition not supported by the source text. This is a major addition error.

errors.source_span: Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the child you will bear
errors.translation_span: 你在妇女中是受福的,你的子女也是受福的
errors.explanation: The translation renders 'the child you will bear' as '你的子女也是受福的' (your children are also blessed), which incorrectly changes singular 'child' into plural 'children,' altering the meaning.

errors.source_span: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord would fulfill his promises to her!

errors.source_span: He has performed mighty deeds with his arm; he has scattered those who are proud in their inmost thoughts.

errors.source_span: just as he promised our ancestors.
errors.translation_span: 照着他的应许,赐给亚伯拉罕和他的后裔永远的恩典.
errors.explanation: The translation adds '赐给...永远的恩典' (gave eternal grace to...), which is an addition not present in the source text, thus altering the meaning slightly.

errors.source_span: To everyone’s astonishment he wrote, “His name is John.”
errors.translation_span: 众人都惊.
errors.explanation: The translation abruptly ends with '众人都惊' (the crowd was astonished) missing the full expression indicating astonishment at seeing the written name, resulting in incomplete fluency and information.

errors.source_span: Everyone who heard this wondered about it, asking, “What then is this child going to be?”
errors.translation_span: 凡听见的人都心里怀疑,说:"这孩子要怎样?"
errors.explanation: The translation uses '心里怀疑' (harbor doubt) which shifts the tone from wondering/pondering to doubting, slightly altering the meaning.

errors.source_span: because he has come to his people and redeemed them.
errors.translation_span: 因为他眷顾了他的百姓,救了他们.
errors.explanation: The phrase '眷顾' (looked upon with care) is a softer expression than 'come to his people,' which implies presence; the idea of 'coming' is less explicit in the translation.

errors.source_span: to enable us to serve him without fear in holiness and righteousness before him all our days.
errors.translation_span: 使我们不惧怕地事奉他,在我们一生中,在他的面前,我们要在圣洁和义上行事.
errors.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is slightly disjointed causing mild fluency issue; the order of ideas could be clearer to reflect original flow.

errors.source_span: by which the rising sun will come to us from heaven
errors.translation_span: 那时,从天上向我们兴起的日光
errors.explanation: The addition of '那时' (at that time) is not present in the source and slightly changes temporal aspect.

errors.source_span: and he lived in the wilderness until he appeared publicly to Israel.
errors.translation_span: 在旷野里住,直到向以色列显现.
errors.explanation: '显现' (appeared) is less explicit about the public nature of the appearance compared to 'appeared publicly'; slight loss of emphasis.

errors.source_span: because Elizabeth was not able to conceive

errors.explanation: The translation mistakenly replaces the subject 'Zechariah' (撒迦利亚) with '子' (son), causing confusion and inaccurate reference.

errors.source_span: your prayer has been heard

errors.source_span: I am Gabriel

errors.explanation: The phrase '惊于' means 'surprised at' which is stronger than 'wondering' and changes the tone.

errors.source_span: They realized he had seen a vision in the temple

errors.source_span: he kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak

errors.explanation: The source implies meaningful signs or gestures to communicate, but '举着手语' only means 'held up sign language' literally, which is inaccurate and unclear.

errors.source_span: After this his wife Elizabeth became pregnant
errors.translation_span: 过了一天,他的妻子伊丽莎白怀孕了

errors.source_span: In these days he has shown his favor and taken away my disgrace among the people

errors.source_span: to Abraham and his descendants forever
